connector.name: Attest
connector.registryDescription: Scan agent payment endpoints (x402, AP2, L402, MPP, 402) for a trust grade A-F before paying.
connector.summary: Hosted at attestagent.org over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package attest-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the attestagents account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
